data: single SYNTHETIC FIFO simulator, not 5G NR
validation: 4 GroupKFold across 72 configurations, 18 held out at a time, 12 of 54 training-side scenarios reserved for validation and NOT used for tuning; 42 train
comparisons: LR and HGB prespecified, not tuned; baseline queueing rules include idealized average service estimated from training-only low latency quantile
mixed: exact same number of training packets as single regime, each packet assigned one of several simulated telemetry variants
heldout_telemetry: 20-ms lag omitted entirely during mixed training; tested only at eval

bootstrap.method: paired scenario-cluster bootstrap on nonoverlapping 4-fold test predictions; 400 resamples; within-scenario packet dependence preserved
